title: The blur-test gate (this PR's acceptance bar) is not wired into any CI gate; the only durable pin tests tokens, not the drawn frame
detail: The ≥15° drawn-frame bar is enforced only by a manually-run script. The token-level test cannot catch the failure mode this PR exists to fix: the briefing's original anchors #CD5C5C (hue 0°) vs #8B4513 (hue 25°) PASS the token test at 25°, yet D2 documents they blur to ~13° drawn (gate-fail). Project rule: acceptance criteria become durable tests, not PR prose.
recommended_fix: Add a ci-local/CI gate line invoking `python3 tools/blur_gate.py` (exit-code checked against the blessed terminal_types golden), or port the sigma-6 pair check into harness palcheck.

title: router_tier_family duplicates the port→tier bucketing already owned by sprite_index_puck; a third variant lives in router_tier_scale
detail: Three tier predicates now exist in render. They agree on today's catalog (4/8/16), but a future port count (e.g. 12) makes the fallback path draw a basic-scale puck with a mid wash/ring.
recommended_fix: Have router_tier_family reuse sprite_index_puck's bucket (or extract one shared tier-of-port_capacity helper) so the tier predicate stays single-sourced.

title: Drive-by deletion of a tracked .pyc unrelated to node-clarity, absent from the PR body's Files list
evidence:
diff.patch: "diff --git a/tools/__pycache__/derive_a11y_palettes.cpython-313.pyc b/tools/__pycache__/derive_a11y_palettes.cpython-313.pyc
deleted file mode 100644
index f807a4d..0000000" ; git log confirms the file was tracked in base 07ade82 and removed by this PR's commit 4900d25.
detail: Benign (a compiled cache should never have been tracked; removing it is good hygiene), but it is undocumented scope creep outside the palette-tokens + draw-layer surface the PR body claims.
recommended_fix: Mention the pyc removal in the PR body's Files section (or split it to a chore commit); optionally add __pycache__/ to .gitignore.
